ev.q: This report describes global polio outbreaks due to cVDPVs during January 2023–June 2024 and updates previous reports.

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; results are by country, region, serotype and period. Security-compromised and hard-to-reach areas are geography raised in discussion and recommendations.

level_alternative.reason: Barriers to reaching children in security-compromised and hard-to-reach communities could be read as an equity concern raised only in recommendations.

equity.equity_measurement: Only geography (country, WHO region, security-compromised areas) is used; no SPD is measured.

notes: Purely descriptive tabulation of outbreaks, cases and detections by country and emergence; no tests or CIs. VP1 divergence and outbreak-confirmation rules are case-definition/lab steps, not procedures. Outbreaks linked to nOPV2 use (29 of 70) are counted, but the report is outbreak epidemiology, so vaccine_outcome_type is left null.
